hero.headline: RCF Franchise & Dealership
hero.subheadline: Explore a franchise and dealership opportunity. Availability, eligibility, support and terms are subject to applicable requirements and company approval.

overview.headline: What is an RCF Franchise?
overview.body: A franchise or dealership arrangement, including product range, territory, supply, any applicable subsidy and support, requires confirmation and approval by the company. Submitting an application does not grant authorization to represent RCF or guarantee acceptance.

highlights.label: Location Review
highlights.desc: Preferred locations are reviewed for availability and suitability.

highlights.label: Company Authorization
highlights.desc: Use of the RCF name or marks requires express written authorization.

highlights.label: Subsidy Information
highlights.desc: Eligibility, amount and terms depend on applicable rules and company approval.

highlights.label: Terms to Confirm
highlights.desc: Any support, training or logistics arrangements are subject to company confirmation.

types.desc: Ideal for individuals with local market knowledge. Sell directly to farmers in your village or panchayat area.
Supply to multiple retailers in your block. Manage a network of sub-dealers with RCF's full logistics support.
Become the primary RCF distributor for your district. Manage block distributors and large institutional clients.

criteria.item: Valid fertilizer retail / wholesale license (or willingness to obtain)
Adequate storage / warehouse space as per tier requirement
PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, and GST registration
Clean financial background with no major loan defaults
Commitment to RCF's code of conduct and pricing guidelines

cta.headline: Interested in Applying?
cta.body: Submit an application for review. Eligibility, availability and terms are subject to company approval.
